basis: Independent inspection of all six actual correctly-routed startup-check OSC payloads, their exact input PCM crops/native references, the actual default multiline template and actual one-enabled-target GUI state. This is source/field-format admission, not quality scoring, main correspondence or universal identity.

actual_template.target_state: First target Japanese for D1/Korean for D3; second and third both No translation in actual direction GUI evidence
actual_template.observed_framing: Exactly two nonblank LF-separated fields: first target translation, then source ASR. Empty secondary-target placeholders are absent from the actual six payloads; no universal renderer or language classifier is inferred.

observations.format: Japanese translation, one LF, English ASR source
Korean translation, one LF, Chinese ASR source

rule.uncertainty: Only actual one-enabled-target default multiline mode is covered. Full-message matching accepts exactly two nonblank lines separated by one LF: target then ASR source. Single-line/source-only/translation-only, blank-field, CRLF, extra-line or other ambiguous payloads remain unresolved with null text/source_text; never reinterpret entire mixed text as translation or fabricate an empty target. ASR source is not reference truth. No universal revision/page/resend/finality/utterance IDs, cross-packet grouping or final-output claim. Changed target count/template requires new observed rule evidence.

consumer_contract.matching: Existing re.fullmatch(text_pattern,payload,re.DOTALL); named translation and source groups are supported without interpreter changes
consumer_contract.mismatch: Existing pattern_mismatch_unresolved_role path retains raw event and output_role unresolved with text/source_text null; no quality-eligible translation inferred
consumer_contract.verification: Source/consumer APIs inspected. Exact six-payload extraction hashes and conservative mismatch cases are supplied for parent-run focused smoke; worker did not execute the interpreter or tests.

binding_policy: Observation clocks/recv_seq/lines/hashes identify only these preflights. Do not copy them into main-run relationships, alignment links or current runtime evidence. Source checks/lifecycle are excluded from main populations; old invalid/blocked evidence stays unchanged.
remote_identity: Existing remote recognition and Developer server translation; D3 FireRedASR2S is only a GUI preference, exact returned remote models/provider routing unknown.
privacy: Public record contains safe template, receipt hashes/locations and operational summaries only; no raw app logs/config/account data or full captured transcripts.
